## HaloBar 0.0.1

The first public build of HaloBar, a native taskbar for Windows 11 in the style of Astraeus.

### Highlights
- **One island instead of a strip.** Your song, apps, tray, quick settings and clock in a single floating island that grows into whatever you open.
- **Everything the Windows taskbar does:** pinned and running apps, window previews, jump lists, the system tray, quick settings, notifications, the calendar and Windows Start.
- **More than it does:** a media player with word-by-word synced lyrics, per-app volume, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth right in the panel, an app launcher with search, notification pills and your Google, Outlook or iCloud calendar.
- **Light on your PC.** Nothing redraws while nothing moves; about 1% CPU with music playing and well under 30 MB of memory.
- **Updates itself.** New versions are checked a few times a day, verified and installed in the background.

> [!NOTE]
> The executable is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may show an "unknown publisher" warning the first time. Click **More info → Run anyway**.
